scope:
Observe real compiled Build25 light instructions on bounded synthetic data.

Warm/cold-I cycles are the existing hwsim scheduling model with perfect D-cache.
Loads/stores and 32-byte demand lines are real executed operand addresses, not
cache misses or bus traffic. Every reference light is at unit distance; the
existing qualified FSRRA(1) implementation suffices for ACTOR_EXACT_FAST=1.
This does not emulate general SH4 approximate reciprocal values or a game scene.

modelled_frame_scenarios.label: MODELLED
modelled_frame_scenarios.assumptions: Synthetic sensitivity only: T_frame = ASSUMED 30 ms other work + 42 copies of this 128-input-vertex lighting fixture (16 in --quick). The same other work is held constant in both arms. No measured room total or character budget is used; real parts, vertices, materials, drawing cadence and overlap are unknown.

exact.scope:
Price actual dynamic instruction traces with the repository's hwsim model.

Perfect caches, no memory/bus/SQ/DMA events and no final completion drain.
This is a synthetic CPU scheduling comparison, never hardware time or FPS.

controls: data read of current opcode word retained
double-register move counted as one 8-byte load
store queues excluded from cached footprint
cached PREF counted separately from demand loads
FMOV XD selects the opposite bank, preserves single-word order and records one8-byteload
FTRV decodes FV4 and accepts the zero homogeneous row used by lights
FIPR source/destination vector decoding and bounded exact integer sum
FSRRA pins only input1 to result1; general reciprocal inputs fail closed
arithmetic_controls.scope: Bounded address-fixture controls, not general SH4 FP qualification

conversion_controls.scope: Existing FTRC toward-zero operation over finite nonnegative values below signed32 overflow; preserves FR/T and has no memory effect. General exceptional FPU behavior untested.

limitations: Synthetic rigid inputs and actual production light routines only. Separately compiled identity hook instructions are included and calls counted; actual model_bridge lookup cost is unpriced. Draw-list traversal, deformation, transforms, clipping, TA output, DMA, scheduling interruptions, device stalls and real D-cache misses are excluded. Cold-I costs depend on the fixture's code layout. No full-frame or private visual/gameplay acceptance.
traffic_scope: Cached architectural demand traffic only. No uncached or store-queue accesses were observed. Unique lines and repeated line visits are not cache misses. Opcode fetches are excluded; literals and stack are included.
